results.details: enterprise privacy contract extends the latest frozen product contract
privacy and enterprise administration operations are versioned explicitly
all mutations use strict v2 vendor media types
every request and response schema is closed
share grants bind a non-empty bounded exact revision
share scope is unique and limited to read or review
revoke is CAS-bound and denies new authorization immediately after commit
metric catalog exactly matches the frozen privacy catalog
queries accept exactly one allowlisted dimension
time buckets exactly match the coarse frozen catalog
public responses omit cell counts, identities and internal hashes
suppressed responses cannot carry a required numeric value and identify only the threshold class
query budget is fixed and atomically consumed
all enterprise mutations require active privileged enterprise membership, CSRF and durable encrypted idempotency
program and cohort mutable boundaries expose exact If-Match fences
left enrollment history cannot be deleted or reactivated
batch enrollment and immutable content references have explicit bounded unique sets
ProgramUpdated additively extends the latest event amendment
ProgramUpdated envelope and payload are closed and start after creation version
ProgramUpdated canonical fixture is deterministic and hash-bound
